Açlık, enerji ve sağlık nasıl çalışır?: How do hunger, energy and health work?
Zamanla acıkır ve yorulursun. Yemek, uyk: Over time you get hungry and tired. Food, sleep and tea refill your energy; bandages, thyme and sleep restore your health. These values never drop below zero, but you slow down when they are low.
Bir oyun günü ne kadar sürer?: How long is a game day?
Bir oyun günü gerçek zamanla 60 dakikadı: One game day lasts 60 real minutes. The story is long, so take your time.
Hikâye perdelere ayrılır; her perde bir: The story is split into acts, and each act is a chain of quests. Quests open in order and can't be skipped. You can see all quests of the act on the 🎯 Goal screen.
Görevde takıldım, ne yapmalıyım?: I'm stuck on a quest. What should I do?
Görev kartındaki «Yol göster» ok ile sen: «Show the way» on the quest card leads you to the goal with an arrow, and the Headman gives hints. If your character is stuck somewhere, tap Settings › «I'm stuck, help».

«Sen yokken» raporu nedir?: What is the «While you were away» report?
Oyun kapalıyken çalışanların en fazla 7: While the game is closed your workers work for up to 7 work days. The report you get when you return shows the work done, the wages paid, Burak's sales and the value of what reached the chest. Workers with nothing to do are not paid.

Çanta üstünde taşıdıklarındır; 60 yerle: The bag is what you carry; it starts with 60 slots and can be upgraded to 90, 120, 200 and 300 from the bag screen. The chest stays at the farm, holds much more and can be upgraded. Workers take from and put into the chest.

Araç sadece yoldan gider; meydanlara, av: Cars only drive on roads; they don't enter squares, your farmyard or buildings, and wait at the nearest roadside. If you're inside a building, go outside first.

Misafir mi oynamalıyım, hesap mı açmalıy: Should I play as a guest or create an account?
Misafir olarak oynayabilirsin ama kaydın: You can play as a guest, but your save stays tied to this device. If you create an account with your email, your progress is saved to the cloud and you can log in and continue even on a new phone. You also need an account to message other players. If you create an account while playing as a guest, your progress is kept, and you can log in with your username instead of your email.
Misafir oyunculara verilen 10 karakterli: A 10-character code given to guest players, shown under Settings › Account & online. Write it down. If you change phones, open «Restore my save with a recovery code» on the same screen. A save restored by code can be up to half an hour behind.
